# Kindred Systems

> Kindred Systems helps established high-value service businesses turn more of the enquiries they already have into paying clients.

Kindred Systems is an independent advisory practice founded by Cathryn Mora, a Lead Conversion Advisor. It works with established high-value service businesses worldwide, examining the full path from first enquiry to signed client, finding where suitable prospects are being lost, and improving the gap with the highest commercial value. The work may involve process, messaging, follow-up, sales conversations, CRM, automation or AI.

## Who this is for

Owners, founders, directors, principals and partners of established service businesses where one new client has meaningful commercial value, the buying decision involves trust and several stages, and the business already generates enough enquiries to show patterns. Delivered worldwide through video calls and online collaboration.

Named examples include cosmetic dentistry and surgery, family and commercial law, financial advice, real estate and buyer's agencies, and premium building and renovation. These are examples, not a complete list of the industries Kindred Systems can help.

## What Kindred Systems offers

- Discovery Call: a private conversation about the current enquiry process, the commercial result the business wants, and whether Lead Conversion Advisory is a suitable next step.
- Lead Conversion Advisory: advisory work tied to a commercial result agreed with the client. It may cover faster first responses, consultations that lead somewhere, quotes and proposals that keep moving, follow-up that helps people decide, a database that produces future opportunities, sales conversations and team consistency, and CRM, automation and AI. Each engagement is scoped around the business and the work required, and pricing is discussed during the Discovery Call.
- Answer Engine Optimisation: a separate service for businesses that want ChatGPT and other answer engines to understand their business and include it in relevant answers. It is available to advisory clients and other businesses, and is not part of a standard Lead Conversion Advisory engagement.

## What Kindred Systems does not do

Guarantee how individual customers will decide, promise a guaranteed recommendation or position in ChatGPT or another answer engine, or recommend new software before establishing whether the systems already in place can support the required process.
